inst.title: Instructions
inst.body:
This app generates SQL queries automatically based on a database schema stored in a JSON file (built-in or uploaded by the user).

On this page, in the field “Ask a question about the data”, write your request in natural language — the AI will turn it into an SQL query. You can display the query itself or immediately see the results as a table.

The demo dataset covers smart-home module sales and includes: object type (house/apartment), area, list of modules (e.g. shutter controller, lighting, RGB) and city. Use those attributes when asking for data.

Example questions:
  • show top 5 best-selling modules in Warsaw with prices
  • show number of sold modules split by house and apartment, include valuation
  • show total and count of module valuations per city

Paste the examples into “Ask a question about the data” or write your own. To use your schema, click “Upload new JSON schema” in the top right — an upload dialog will appear. Here you will generate queries based on the provided JSON schema.
